title: Member Journey HMM
description: A sequence model whose hidden states are read as journey stages. Fixes the state count to a number a person can hold in their head and name; a 12-state fit may score better and cannot be talked about, which defeats the point of choosing this archetype.

n_components.description: Journey stages. Bounded low on purpose — these get named and discussed.

stage_labels.description: Optional names for the fitted states, in order. Naming them is what turns a state index into something a person can act on.
